title: Multi-stage structured catalyst system for post-treatment of GHGs emitted from industrial processes
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE00847F, Paper
Choji Fukuhara, Hiroto Naiki, Hiroshi Akama, Yuki Yamada, Priyanka Verma, Ryo Watanabe
Multi-stage catalytic system valorizes CO2 by integrating methanation, dry reforming, and carbon capture. It converts CO2 to CH4, syngas, and solid carbon in continuous flow. Spiral catalysts and flow meters enable efficient H2 recycling.
